_source: Site-wide contact and company details, in one place. Read by website/_src/build.py (footer, Organization JSON-LD) and as {{site:...}} tokens in page fragments. The enquiry function (clwydian-academy 2/api/enquiry.js) cannot read this file at run time, so it repeats the email address; scripts/test_enquiry.js fails if the two differ.

registered_office._note: LEGAL QUESTION PENDING WITH THE PM — do not change without their instruction. This is the only place the address is written: change these two lines (English and Welsh forms of the same address) and rebuild. It appears in the footer of /funding/ and /cy/ffioedd-a-chyllid/ only.
